# Fix the gaps

Inner-loop ids remain (verify failed, claimed done unverified, or a wiring `G#`). The step (1.168.0): the reason once, in one plain sentence about the first id, then the label and the command alone, for example reason `T6's four tests fail on stale asserts at the PR's tip.`, label `Fix T6:`, command `/crav1-fix-build-gaps <slug> T6`. More than one id: label `Fix T6, then T8:` and `/crav1-fix-build-gaps <slug>` with no Gap, which walks them in order. A tick-pending Gap is not an inner-loop id.
